I found these by searching for `IssueStatus` across all `.ts`/`.tsx` files. The list covers every file that names the type: the defining file `src/types/issue.ts`, plus files that import it or use it in an annotation, a type argument (`Map<IssueStatus, …>`), a `Record` key or a type guard.

What I left out:
- Files that only contain similar names, such as `changeIssueStatus`, `ChangeIssueStatusInput`, `defaultIssueStatus` or `IssueStatusSelect`.
- The `scripts/manifest-parts/*` files, which mention `IssueStatus` only inside string literals.

One judgement call: I included the test file `tests/components/board-model.test.ts`. It imports the type and uses it in an annotation and in `as IssueStatus` casts. Drop it if "source file" means production code only.

The two `Record<IssueStatus, …>` maps, `STATUS_LABELS` in `src/lib/format.ts` and `STATUS_TONE` in `src/components/domain/issue/issue-tone.ts`, will fail to compile until the new status gets an entry.

ANSWER: src/types/issue.ts, src/types/event.ts, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/projects/[projectSlug]/issues/page.tsx, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/projects/[projectSlug]/issues/new/page.tsx, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/issues/page.tsx, src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts, src/server/db/seed.ts, src/schemas/issue.ts, src/components/domain/board/board-model.ts, src/components/domain/board/kanban-board.tsx, src/components/domain/issue/issue-filter-bar.tsx, src/components/domain/issue/issue-tone.ts, src/components/domain/issue/issue-status-select.tsx, src/hooks/optimistic-issues-reducer.ts, src/hooks/issue-filter-params.ts, src/hooks/use-optimistic-issues.ts, src/lib/format.ts, tests/components/board-model.test.ts
